title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
summary: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments, enabling long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.
body: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments, enabling long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布计划收购Ona，旨在为Codex扩展安全、持久的云端开发环境。此举将赋能AI智能体在企业工作流中执行长周期的复杂任务，显著提升自动化编码和工程效率，是AI Agent基础设施演进的重要动态。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI计划收购Ona以增强Codex的云端运行能力，赋能企业长运行AI智能体。
